svg.text: Glean RAG Chatbot — Architecture & Data Flow (Node.js/TypeScript)
Three integration paths: Web UI, REST API, and MCP Tool | Three Glean APIs: Indexing, Search, Chat
1. User asks question in React web interface
2. MCP server receives request via stdio
4. Returns structured JSON to MCP client
4. Use for: Slack bots, Discord, internal tools
🔧 Setup Flow: One-Time Indexing (npm run index)
1. Read all .md files from corpus/ directory
2. Generate stable IDs via content hash (idempotent)
3. POST to Glean Indexing API with permissions
⏱️ Indexing: ~1 second | Documents searchable in 90 seconds
First request slower (cold start) | Subsequent requests cached
✓ Idempotent indexing | ✓ Citation validation | ✓ Three token separation
Node.js 18+ | TypeScript 5 | Express | React 18 | Vite | MCP SDK
